formula.additive.explanation: Base Multiplier = 1.15 for Aggravate, 1.25 for Spread. This amount is ADDED DIRECTLY onto the base damage of the triggering hit BEFORE CRIT/DMG% multipliers are applied — so it still benefits from the triggering hit's CRIT Rate/DMG%, unlike Transformative reactions.
formula.additive.title: Additive Reactions (Aggravate, Spread)
formula.amplifying.explanation: Base Multiplier = 2 for the “forward” direction (Hydro applied to existing Pyro for Vaporize, Pyro applied to existing Cryo for Melt), = 1.5 for the “reverse” direction. The Amplifying Multiplier is applied DIRECTLY to the triggering hit's damage — it still benefits from ATK, CRIT Rate/DMG, and DMG% bonuses as normal, unlike the other two categories.
formula.amplifying.title: Amplifying Reactions (Melt / Vaporize)
formula.lunarStellar.explanation: Fandom confirms Lunar and Stellar reactions share the SAME formula (unlike standard Transformative reactions, this one CAN CRIT — the character's CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG factor in — and is calculated PER CHARACTER individually, not for a single triggering character). If multiple characters apply the relevant elements (up to 4): the highest individual damage counts 100%, the second counts 50%, the third and fourth each count only 1/12 — all 4 portions are summed for the final Lunar/Stellar damage. Base Multiplier for Lunar-Charged = 1.8 (some characters like Ineffa have a “direct” hit using its own separate Base Multiplier, not this number).
formula.lunarStellar.title: Lunar & Stellar Reactions (Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize, Stellar-Conduct, Stellar-Swirl)
formula.transformative.explanation: Level Multiplier at Lv.90 = 1446.85, Lv.80 = 1077.44 (based on the level of the character that TRIGGERS the reaction, not the target). CANNOT crit, completely ignores the target's DEF, and is only affected by Elemental RES — so the triggering character's ATK/CRIT/DMG% have NO effect at all; only Elemental Mastery (EM) and character level matter.
formula.transformative.title: Transformative Reactions (Overloaded, Superconduct, Electro-Charged, Swirl, Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, Shatter...)
hexerei.description: Each Hexerei character gets their own individual talent/skill/constellation upgrade when teamed up with another Hexerei character — not a shared stat buff for the whole party like Elemental Resonance.
hexerei.name: Hexerei: Secret Rite
hexerei.requirement: Older Mondstadt characters must complete "Witch's Homework" to unlock Hexerei eligibility; the new witches (Nicole/Lohen/Prune) have it by default without needing the quest. Requires ≥2 Hexerei characters in the team to activate the effect.
lunar.description: Whenever a character WITHOUT a Moonsign uses their Elemental Skill or Burst, the whole party gains a 20-second Lunar Reaction DMG Bonus buff, calculated from that character's own stats. This does NOT stack — using another skill refreshes it to the new value instead of adding to it.
lunar.name: Lunar Resonance
lunar.requirement: Requires a team Moonsign Level of Ascendant Gleam (≥2 Moonsign characters, e.g. Ineffa/Flins/Aino/Lauma/Nefer in the team).
reaction.aggravate.description: Electro acting on a target with a Quicken mark. ADDS Electro DMG onto the triggering hit (not multiplicative like Amplifying reactions) — coefficient 1.15, see Damage Formula section for details.
reaction.aggravate.name: Aggravate
reaction.bloom.description: Dendro meets Hydro. Creates a Dendro Core (Seed Core) — after a short delay, it explodes on its own, dealing area Dendro DMG.
reaction.bloom.name: Bloom
reaction.burgeon.description: Pyro acting on a Dendro Core (after Bloom). The Core explodes over a larger area, dealing Pyro DMG.
reaction.burgeon.name: Burgeon
reaction.burning.description: Pyro meets Dendro. Deals continuous Pyro DMG over time within the burning area, which can spread to nearby plants/Dendro-affected targets.
reaction.burning.name: Burning
reaction.crystallize.description: Geo meets Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro. Creates a protective crystal shard of the corresponding element — pick it up for an elemental shield.
reaction.crystallize.name: Crystallize
reaction.electro-charged.description: Electro meets Hydro. Deals continuous Electro DMG over time, which can jump to nearby targets affected by Hydro.
reaction.electro-charged.name: Electro-Charged
reaction.frozen.description: Cryo meets Hydro. Freezes the target, disabling their actions for a short time — Frozen itself deals no damage. A follow-up "Shatter" hit (from Claymores or Geo skills) then deals damage, calculated using the Transformative Reaction formula (see Damage Formula section).
reaction.frozen.name: Frozen
reaction.hyperbloom.description: Electro acting on a Dendro Core (after Bloom). The Core turns into a homing projectile that seeks out a target, dealing Electro DMG.
reaction.hyperbloom.name: Hyperbloom
reaction.lunar-bloom.description: An upgraded version of Bloom — creates up to 3 drops of Verdant Dew for related characters to consume, dealing DMG that CAN CRIT.
reaction.lunar-bloom.name: Lunar-Bloom
reaction.lunar-charged.description: An upgraded version of Electro-Charged, triggered when a suitable Moonsign character is present — summons a thundercloud that deals continuous Electro DMG over time, which CAN CRIT.
reaction.lunar-charged.name: Lunar-Charged
reaction.lunar-crystallize.description: An upgraded version of Crystallize — summons 3 Moondrift shards. Once all 3 are collected, deals a single hit of DMG that CAN CRIT.
reaction.lunar-crystallize.name: Lunar-Crystallize
reaction.melt.description: Pyro meets Cryo (or vice versa). Multiplies the damage of the triggering hit: x2 if Pyro is applied to existing Cryo, x1.5 if Cryo is applied to existing Pyro.
reaction.melt.name: Melt
reaction.overloaded.description: Pyro meets Electro. Deals area Pyro DMG and knocks back the target and nearby targets.
reaction.overloaded.name: Overloaded
reaction.quicken.description: Dendro meets Electro. Applies a Quicken mark to the target — deals no immediate damage, but sets up Aggravate/Spread.
reaction.quicken.name: Quicken
reaction.spread.description: Dendro acting on a target with a Quicken mark. ADDS Dendro DMG onto the triggering hit (not multiplicative like Amplifying reactions) — coefficient 1.25, see Damage Formula section for details.
reaction.spread.name: Spread
reaction.stellar-conduct.description: An upgraded version of Superconduct: creates a Starlight Prism, turning the surrounding area into a Polestar Field — Electro/Cryo/Stellar-Conduct deal bonus DMG to targets within the field.
reaction.stellar-conduct.name: Stellar-Conduct
reaction.stellar-swirl.description: An upgraded version of Cryo Swirl: deals an immediate hit, then creates a Polestar Wind Cluster (Cryo) that explodes after a delay, dealing area Cryo DMG. Both hits CAN CRIT.
reaction.stellar-swirl.name: Stellar-Swirl
reaction.superconduct.description: Cryo meets Electro. Deals area Cryo DMG and reduces the target's Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds.
reaction.superconduct.name: Superconduct
reaction.swirl.description: Anemo meets Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro. Deals area DMG of the element that was swept up (Pyro Swirl deals Pyro DMG, Electro Swirl deals Electro DMG, etc.) — NOT Anemo DMG. Exception: Hydro Swirl deals no damage, it only spreads Wet status. Also spreads that element to surrounding targets (excluding the original target).
reaction.swirl.name: Swirl
reaction.vaporize.description: Pyro meets Hydro (or vice versa). Multiplies the damage of the triggering hit: x2 if Hydro was applied to existing Pyro, x1.5 if Pyro was applied to existing Hydro.
reaction.vaporize.name: Vaporize
resonance.enduring-rock.description: Increases ATK by 15% for characters protected by a shield. Reduces the chance of being interrupted and DMG taken from strong attacks.
resonance.enduring-rock.name: Enduring Rock
resonance.fervent-flames.description: Reduces Frozen duration by 40%. Increases ATK by 25% for the whole party.
resonance.fervent-flames.name: Fervent Flames
resonance.high-voltage.description: Reduces Wet duration by 40%. Superconduct/Overloaded/Electro-Charged have a 100% chance to generate 1 additional Electro Elemental Particle (5-second cooldown).
resonance.high-voltage.name: High Voltage
resonance.impetuous-winds.description: Increases Movement SPD by 10% and Stamina Regen SPD. Reduces Stamina consumption by 15%. Reduces Skill/Burst CD by 5%.
resonance.impetuous-winds.name: Impetuous Winds
resonance.protective-canopy.description: Increases the whole party's Dendro RES (further increased when combined with another element).
resonance.protective-canopy.name: Protective Canopy
resonance.shattering-ice.description: Reduces Electro-Charged duration by 40%. Increases CRIT Rate by 15% against enemies who are Frozen or affected by Cryo.
resonance.shattering-ice.name: Shattering Ice
resonance.soothing-water.description: Reduces Burning duration by 40%. Increases healing effectiveness by 30% for the whole party.
resonance.soothing-water.name: Soothing Water
witchRevelation.description: Unlocks an additional talent plus C1/C2/C4/C6 constellation upgrades. While standing within a Polestar Field created by Stellar-Conduct, the character enters Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, gaining additional Stellar-Conduct effects/damage.
witchRevelation.name: Witch's Revelation
witchRevelation.requirement: Own the character at ≥Lv.70, complete "Revelations by Chance" to obtain the Revelation Box, then complete each character's individual Revelation quest.
